enemies.name: Baranov
enemies.description: A broad man in a dark coat, moving at the unhurried pace of someone with hours still to go on his shift.

enemies.name: Zima
enemies.description: A compact man with a night-shift expression, moving between the kitchen and the yard on a circuit he has done a hundred times.

enemies.name: Petrov
enemies.description: A guard standing near the far end of the corridor with the stillness of someone who has been here a long time and expects to be here longer.

enemies.name: Volkov
enemies.description: A tall man in a dark suit, moving between the landing and the far room at an even pace. He checks his watch at each end of the circuit.

enemies.name: Irina Molova
enemies.description: The duty nurse, seated at her desk with her back to the door, reading.
